title: Simon 6.3.2(3): the local mass of an integer multiplicity current is the weight of its varifold
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple representing T. Then for every open W ⊆ U, M_W(T) = ∫_{M∩W} θ dH^n, i.e. T.massOn W = R.measure W (mass computed with the Euclidean coefficient norm of covectors).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → T.massOn W = R.measure W
